system.summary: Reciprocal letter substitution (12 pairs: a-z b-s c-q d-e f-n g-o h-u i-r k-y l-t m-x p-w) in Latin letters, German and Latin plaintext, word division kept; names and titles in separate signs listed in the file's Catalogus (frame 3).
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the cipher letters of the combined training text f.5+f.6 (24). The key worksheet on frame 168 writes the key as AMPHICTYONES over zxwurqlkgfdb. Name signs are left as holes ('|' in the transcriptions); unread_groups 0 because they were not transcribed as groups.

prior_solution.where: Clear drafts of f.5, f.6 recto and verso (the verso is the page labelled f.7) and f.101 (the enciphered passages underlined) in LASA A 1 Nr. 529, frames 875, 881-882 and 532; found 13 Nov 2026 after the key was recovered and the slips decoded. No decipherment found for f.102, f.104, f.204 in the Nr. 529 frames searched; Nr. 543 (Krull's draft reports) not checked. The file holds the contemporary key worksheet (frame 168). Details: PRIOR_ART.md, nr529/README.md. f.204 prior art not cleared: it lies in the frames 226-259 Annotationes run linked to the Nr. 529 diary margin notes, and diary No. 40 was not searched (PR #558). Beling addition (PR #578): the envoys' clear copies of the 1645 annexes No. 31 (Nr. 530 f. 212) and No. 32 (ff. 210-211) are in LASA A 1 Nr. 540 Bd. 1, f. 585r-v (frames 633-634) and ff. 599r-600v (frames 648-650); found 12 Nov 2026 and used for those two readings (nr540/README.md); frame 633 checked at integration.

conditions.human_role: Malcolm McBratney directed the work and set the rules (prior art first, transcriptions frozen before one decode, shuffled-key controls, a second reader, every attempt recorded, the reproduced figure used where a ledger does not reproduce) and supplied the Nr. 529 lead from his second checker (Perplexity); Claude sessions found the slips, transcribed, recovered the key, decoded, counted and checked. No reading by a person without AI.
tools: own simulated-annealing solver with a German 4-gram model (scripts/original/solve_mono.py)
own decoder, ledger recount and confirmation scripts (scripts/build.py, confirm.py, compare_nr529.py; standard library)
shuffled-key control, 5,000 keys, German 4-gram model on Simplicissimus with a corpus guard (scripts/shuffle_control.py)
models: Claude (Anthropic), sessions b160 and b162 of 12 Nov 2026 (model ids not recorded)
claude-opus-5-5 (b189, the session that prepared this folder and checked Nr. 529)

solution.what: LASA A 1 Nr. 530 (catalogue row 1639) surveyed from the max jpg images: bare cipher slips on frames 8, 10, 11, 117, 118, 121, 233; Catalogus of name signs on frame 3; glossed postscript on frame 51; key worksheet on frame 168.
f.5 transcribed (v1 13:40:46 UTC, v2 with two re-reads 13:44:48) and frozen before any solve; f.6 frozen 13:45:51 before any decode.

KEY_v1 from f.5 alone (seeds 3,4,5 identical, frozen 13:45:23 UTC md5 c892c744); f.6 held out: 35/101 = 34.65%. KEY_v2 from f.5+f.6 (frozen 13:47:27 UTC md5 c8fade56): an exact reciprocal table, no hand edit. Rerun on 13 Nov: byte-identical.

Held-out slips frozen then decoded once each with KEY_v2 (reader R1): f.7 36/83 = 43.37%, f.102 28/81 = 34.57%, f.104 45/101 = 44.55%, f.204 24/51 = 47.06% (the ledger's 24/53 does not reproduce). Below the contributor's own 65% line.
5,000 shuffled keys at seeds 20261112 and 7, German 4-gram model: 0 of 5,000 reach the true score in all 18 runs (9 transcriptions x 2 seeds).

Key against the file's own material, after the freeze: Catalogus frame 3, 8/13 name words exact (9/13 with m=x; the 13/13 in our log does not reproduce); postscript glosses frame 51, 11/18 words exact, 104/118 letters position by position; worksheet frame 168 (AMPHICTYONES), 12/12 pairs.

Second reader (b162, glossed reference crops, own freezes, one decode each): f.7 38/81, f.104 46/101 (ledger says 47; recounted 46), f.102 31/79, f.204 22/51, f.101 16/35. Word agreement with reader 1: 162/312 = 51.92%.

LASA A 1 Nr. 529 (envoys' draft diary) searched on a lead from Malcolm McBratney's second checker (Perplexity): clear drafts found for f.5 (frame 875), f.6 and f.7 (881-882) and f.101 (532); none found for f.102, f.104, f.204 in the frames searched.

Our reading of the Nr. 529 clear drafts enciphered with KEY_v2 and compared letter by letter with the frozen transcriptions: f.5 248/271 = 91.51%, f.6 364/419 = 86.87%; 1,000 random reciprocal keys at two seeds: none reaches it (best 114, 186).

Integration check (PR #524, report R8_bremen): all scripts re-run with python3 -I, byte-identical; original annealer re-run on f.5+f.6 (fresh Gutenberg 55171) converges to KEY_v2; own decoder from the frame-168 worksheet agrees with every KEY_v2 decryption except words with cipher m (worksheet m = x); LASA frames 168, 233, 278 fetched: worksheet confirmed, f.204 lines 1-3 compared (about 15/24 R1 words agree, R2 closer), frame 278 is a glossed sign catalogue not yet used. Texts set to decoded, not read; fraction_read 149/351 over the five held-out slips; 'illegible' gap corrected to not-attempted; target kept in progress.

Third reader R3 (contributor's session b195): f.7, f.102, f.104 and f.204 re-transcribed from the LASA images with a sign reference (gloss/REF_SIGNS_R3.md), not blind (key known; reader 2's read-word lists seen), each frozen and RFC 3161 stamped (10:50:57-10:59:38 GMT), decoded once with KEY_v2 at 11:00:22 by the contributor's record. Strict with borderline units as holes: f.102 53/84 = 63.10%, f.104 71/102 = 69.61%, f.204 42/51 = 82.35% (contributor's literal figures 72.62%, 71.57%, 88.24%). f.7 against its Nr. 529 draft (frame 882): 41/59 exact words, letters 318/341 = 93.26%.

Integration check of the R3 files (R8, AI agent): decode_R3.py, mkledger_R3.py and valscore_R3.py re-run with python3 -I, byte-identical; four b195 stamp imprints equal the manifests, which hold the frozen R3 transcriptions; frame 233 compared: word count and sign positions agree, one word-seeking letter seen (image tbdf, R3 tzbdf = lasen, a borderline unit); frame 882 of Nr. 529 holds the f.7 draft as stated. R3 figures filed per slip as a labelled third reading, not figures of record (non-blind); outcome.method set to 'read with known key' by the owner's decision.

Integration check of the blind fourth reading b198 (R8, AI agent): both RFC 3161 tokens (Sectigo, 11:32:42 and 11:35:17 GMT) verify with openssl ts -verify and their imprints equal the manifests; the freeze manifest holds the three frozen transcriptions. Own decoder from the frame-168 worksheet: 236/236 units equal the reader's decodes; ledger reproduces (S+SP 33/84, 49/100, 25/52). Strict recount with doubtful-letter words as holes: f.102 22/84, f.104 42/100, f.204 19/52. Frame 233 against the transcription: 36 of 50 words agree, 3 differ, 11 undecidable. Blind to other readings, not to the key. Adopted as figures of record for the three slips (better documented than R1); fraction_read 135/354 = 0.3814. Status stays in progress (hand, frame 278, drafts workable).

Correction by the contributor (PR #558): the slip labelled f.7 (frame 11 left) is fol. 6 verso, the second page of dispatch No. 32, not a separate slip; so the b160 held-out test of KEY_v2 on it held out the other page of the dispatch whose recto trained KEY_v2. Checked at integration on LASA frames 10-12 (frame 10 right f.6r headed 'ad Diarium No. 32'; frame 11 left the same slip turned, right page foliated 7 and blank; frame 12 left f.7v endorsed 'ad Diarium No. 32'). The contributor's frame md5 values cannot be re-checked (the viewer stamps the request time into each image). Labels only; no count changes. f.204 prior art reopened: Nr. 529 diary No. 40, Nr. 545, Nr. 546 still to check.

Beling addition: pre-registered tests of a letter key built from the frame-4 name-sign booklet (left page): booklet right page 0.8659 of clear letters, best of 200 shuffled 0.2793; frame-278 gloss pairs (23) 0.8889, best shuffled 0.4314; both pass the bar fixed in advance (0.85, margin 0.30). Not blind (frame 278 seen first). Rescored with the worksheet key 13 Nov: 146/153, 18/23 words exact (gloss/frame278_BEL/).

Beling addition: frames 161-162, 250-259 and f.102/f.104 transcribed by two AI readers blind to each other and without the key (files hashed), then reconciled on the image (context-assisted); Nos. 31 and 32 of 1645 (frames 240-243) from earlier reconciled rounds.
Beling addition: Nos. 31 and 32 of 1645 read with the envoys' clear copies in Nr. 540 Bd. 1 open (source-assisted, not independent); other annexes decoded with partial readings only.

Beling addition: word-by-word readings with per-word ledgers and English for f139 (No. 20), f224 (No. 21) and f212 (No. 31; source-assisted, aligned with the Nr. 540 clear copy): strict 42/72, 160/256, 187/328; with look-alikes 55/72, 201/256, 231/328. _check_reading clean shares 0.143, 0.222, 0.121 with repairs marked, so all stay 'decoded, not read'. Two transcription errors in f212 corrected after an independent image check (51 words: 37 confirmed, 10 differ, 4 not legible).

Integration check of the Beling addition (PR #578): beling_build.py --check reproduces all ten decodes and an own decoder written from the 12 pairs gives 0 differing lines of 417; cipher-word counts reproduce (3,429 in the eight annexes, 386 records; plus 84 and 103 for f.102, f.104). All eleven SHA-256 values of gloss/frame278_BEL match and the three scripts reproduce 0.8659 / 0.2793 and 0.8889 / 0.4314 (pass by the bar written in PREREG, by the contributor's record of the order) and 146/153, 18/23 with the worksheet key. Word ledgers recount to S/L/R/E 42/13/15/2, 160/41/50/5, 187/44/83/14; with words on an unsettled glyph counted as holes (the rule used for b198) the strict shares are f139 41/72 = 0.5694, f224 139/256 = 0.5430, f212 187/328 = 0.5701. Images (LASA viewer, max jpg): frame 162 69 of 72 words agree, frame 242 lines 1-6 48 of 52, the rest look-alikes; frame 278 ten of the 23 gloss pairs seen as transcribed; Nr. 540 Bd. 1 frame 633 is the clear copy of No. 31. All added texts stay 'decoded, not read' and out of fraction_read (0.3814 unchanged). Status stays in progress.

outcome.method_basis: Owner's decision (13 Nov 2026): 'read with known key', because the envoys' own key survives in the same volume (Nr. 530 frame 168, keyword AMPHICTYONES over zxwurqlkgfdb, all 12 pairs equal) and decodes the slips to the same letters (cipher m = x added). The facts behind it: KEY_v2 was found by simulated annealing on the ciphertext of f.5 and f.6 alone and frozen (13:47:27 UTC, 12 Nov 2026) before frame 168 was seen (14:00:36), by the contributor's record; the worksheet then confirmed it 12/12; the catalogue entry the work started from already said a key was in the file. The label is the conservative one chosen by the owner for the paper.
outcome.fraction_read_source: the five held-out slips at their figures of record, first pass with frozen KEY_v2, no selection: f.7 36/83 (R1), f.101 16/35 (R2), f.102 22/84, f.104 42/100, f.204 19/52 (blind fourth reader b198, blind4_b198/dec/*.ledger.tsv, words with a letter marked doubtful counted as holes) = 135/354 = 0.3814 (13 Nov 2026, R8; was 149/351 = 0.4245 with R1 on f.102, f.104, f.204). Unit = cipher word.
